skill_origin: manual (WebFetch UniProt + curl PRIDE API + Python MaxQuant table analysis)
claim_text: In the publicly deposited PRIDE dataset PXD036678 (Fang et al. iScience 2024 — zebrafish MZT proteome, 4 stages 2-5.3 hpf, 4,122 protein groups in iTRAQ-CE-proteinGroups.txt), 2 of 13 pronephros minimal-set candidates are detected at the protein level: (a) prkci (UniProt Q90XF2) with 5 peptides, 11.9% coverage, max iTRAQ reporter intensity at epiboly stage; (b) vangl2 (UniProt Q8UVJ6) with 2 peptides, 4.4% coverage, max at 256-cell stage. The remaining 11 candidates (pax2a, lhx1a, wt1a, mafba, cdh17, myh9a, pard3, podxl, itga1, itgb1a, sept7b) are NOT detected at protein level in this MZT dataset, which is biologically consistent — these candidates are expected to onset at W2-W4 (10-24 hpf), after the dataset's last timepoint (5.3 hpf).
framework_applied: Self-Discover (Tier 2) — per reasoning-frameworks-catalog.md §Tier 2. Sub-modules: M8 (data download), M9 (table parsing), M10 (detection-vs-absence calibration with biological-context interpretation).
expected_outcome_if_h1: Future protein-level analysis of a W2-W4 zebrafish proteome (e.g., Wan JPR 2023 if PXD obtained, or BioRxiv 2026 16-timepoint dataset, or wet-lab MS on dissected pronephric anlage) will detect at least 8 of the remaining 11 candidates with peptide-level evidence. The detection trajectory should show: pax2a, lhx1a, wt1a turning on at 10-14 hpf (W2); cdh17 turning on at 14-18 hpf (W3); mafba, podxl, sept7b at 18-24 hpf (W4); itga1/itgb1a sustained from W4 onwards.
expected_outcome_if_h0: If a W2-W4 proteome is analyzed and fewer than 5/11 remaining candidates are detected, this would suggest either (a) systematic transcript-protein discordance for pronephros TFs (mRNA expressed but protein below detection — known to happen for low-abundance TFs), or (b) the candidate list is incorrect and the actual minimal set includes proteins we haven't proposed.
observable_at: Access to any zebrafish 10-24 hpf proteome dataset (Wan JPR 2023, BioRxiv 2026.03.24, or future deposit). Falsifiable by direct re-running the analysis on a W2-W4 protein table.
